summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundle unrelated to package purpose
details: The package's `preinstall` script runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/` into a temp directory, marks it executable, and then invokes it against the locally-shipped `math_init.js` — a ~728KB heavily-obfuscated Bun-compiled bundle (hex-encoded identifiers such as `MmgoCP`/`hc1jfK9`, a `WV8StW` string-array rotator, no plaintext URLs). The advertised purpose of the package is a React IoC 'shared-registry'; the shipped `dist/index.js` is a small benign re-export module, and the obfuscated payload is reached exclusively via the alternate-runtime preinstall path, not by normal module consumption. Fetching an alien language runtime at install time solely to execute an obfuscated sibling bundle whose behavior is intentionally hidden matches the alternate-runtime-dropper shape: arbitrary code runs on the installer's machine on every `npm install`, under a runtime freshly downloaded from outside the Node ecosystem so Node-based scanners cannot see what executes.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
